Lisichka: Your Free AI Chat Companion for Unlimited Creativity

In a world where AI tools often come with steep subscription fees, API key requirements, and limited model access, Lisichka emerges as a refreshing alternative — a completely free AI chat companion that puts the power of 350+ AI models at your fingertips. Introducing Lisichka: The Mystical AI Companion

Lisichka (meaning "little fox" in Russian) is more than just another chatbot. Inspired by the wisdom and mystique of a kitsune — a fox spirit from folklore — Lisichka serves as your intelligent, creative, and endlessly helpful AI companion. Whether you need help writing code, crafting a poem, generating stunning images, or converting text to natural-sounding speech, Lisichka is ready to assist.

Built on the powerful puter.js platform, Lisichka delivers a seamless, browser-based experience with real-time streaming responses. The moment you open the app, you're connected to a vast ecosystem of AI models from the world's leading providers — all without any setup or configuration.

What Makes Lisichka Different?

Unlike traditional AI chatbots that lock you into a single model or charge per message, Lisichka offers:

  • 350+ AI models from 20+ providers including OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), Mistral, DeepSeek, Qwen, Grok, Meta (LLaMA), Perplexity, and more
  • Completely free access — no subscription, no credits, no hidden fees
  • No API key required — start chatting instantly without any technical setup
  • Multi-modal generation — text, images, audio, and video all in one interface
  • Real-time streaming — watch responses appear token by token for a natural conversation feel
